'''1999 Decipher World Championship Clint Hays DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Clint Hays]] and [[Steven Lewis]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds93.htm Hays' Hunt Down], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029141010/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds93.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Clint Hays]] and [[Steven Lewis]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hays' Hunt Down
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Decipher World Championship]]
